SELECT s.GSoffered
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.Longitude = (
    SELECT MAX(s2.Longitude)
    FROM satscores s2
    WHERE s2.cds = s.cds
);

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN card cc ON c.client_id = cc.client_id
JOIN disp d ON cc.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE cc.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a 
     JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
     JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
     JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id 
     WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
     GROUP BY m.molecule_id
     HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a 
     JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
     JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
     JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id 
     WHERE b.bond_type = '#')
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id 
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT c.Comment, c.CreationDate, c.Score, c.PostId, c.UserId, c.UserDisplayName
FROM comments c
WHERE c.UserId = 'A Lion.'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate;

SELECT DISTINCT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MIN(Reputation) FROM users);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
JOIN votes v ON p.PostId = v.PostId
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Matt Parker'
AND v.VoteTypeId = 1
AND v.BountyAmount > 4;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Gold'
  AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM hero_power;

SELECT r.driverId, r.number
FROM results r
JOIN races r2 ON r.raceId = r2.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN qualifying q ON r2.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN status s ON q.statusId = s.statusId
WHERE q.number = 903
  AND s.status = '+1 Lap'
  AND q.q3 LIKE 'M:SS%'
  AND r2.round = 3
  AND r2.date = '1950-05-13';

SELECT DISTINCT
  driverId
FROM driverStandings
WHERE raceId = (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE circuitId = (
    SELECT circuitId
    FROM circuits
  )
  ORDER BY position = 1
  LIMIT 5
);

SELECT AVG(results.points) AS average_score
FROM results
WHERE raceId = 1950_British_Grand_Prix
  AND statusId = 136
  AND constructorId = 1
  AND driverId = 1
  AND position = 1
  AND positionText = '1';

SELECT AVG(height)
FROM Player
WHERE birthday >= '1990-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND birthday < '1996-01-01 00:00:00';

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Examination E
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND P.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND P.Admission = '+'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.ID = P.Laboratory.ID
      AND L.Date LIKE '1995-09-04'
      AND L.GOT = 1
      AND L.GPT = 1
      AND L.LDH = 123
  );

SELECT e.ID, e.SEX, e.AGE
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.BLOOD_GLUE >= 180 AND e.T-CHO < 250;

SELECT DISTINCT
    EXAMINATION.Patient.ID,
    EXAMINATION.Patient.Birthday
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
